lore.text: Selina Kyle and her sister Maggie were raised by an abusive father and a mother who died when Selina was young. In order to survive, Selina began stealing at an early age, learning how to climb to inaccessible areas, pick locks, and evade police. She also learned to fight. Ultimately leaving home, Selina managed to survive on the streets of Gotham as a cat burglar and con-woman. She was disguised as an old woman when she tried to pull a heist on a luxury boat, but was exposed by Batman and Robin in one of the sidekick's earliest field missions. Robin noticed the chemistry between Batman and Catwoman right away, though Batman dismissed his observation.

While bizarre criminals like The Joker, the Riddler, Scarecrow, and the Penguin were rising in Gotham, forming alliances and rivalries, Catwoman mostly kept to herself, stealing from the most appealing targets, including other criminals. She made an enemy of the crime boss Black Mask, who discovered Selina's true identity and found her sister Maggie, who had married and was leading a normal life. Black Mask brutally murdered Maggie's husband and tortured Maggie in order to lure Catwoman into a trap. Catwoman shot Black Mask and saved Maggie, but the trauma had shattered Maggie's sanity.

In a turn of events, Catwoman discovered she was the heir to the Calabrese crime family. Selina decided to hang up her costume to run the criminal empire. Her plan was to unite the criminal families of Gotham City in order to rebuild the city rather than prey on the weak and vulnerable. Of course, many criminal families and supervillains resisted her ambitious goals, with Black Mask emerging as her fiercest opponent, creating his own criminal allied faction. Selina would come out victorious against Black Mask, though at the cost of her own leadership and empire, leaving control to her half-sister, Antonia Calabrese. While she could not contain crime as a mob leader, she could still interfere in and battle against it as Catwoman.

Catwoman joined Gotham villains Poison Ivy and Harley Quinn as the Gotham City Sirens. They pulled heists but also opposed dangerous criminals and became friends. Ivy and Harley helped Selina when the undead Black Lantern version of Black Mask sought revenge, going after her sister Maggie in her mental institution. Later, Harley decided to kill The Joker for the wrongs he'd done her. She broke into Arkham Asylum, triggering a riot that Ivy and Catwoman got involved in. Batman put it down, arresting everyone but Catwoman. Ivy and Harley broke out to kill Catwoman for leaving them behind. But Selina revealed she'd been using her connection to Batman to prevent them from being arrested because she saw good in them. As Batman closed in, Catwoman helped them escape a final time.

When Catwoman was sentenced to death for multiple murders, Batman proved she was innocent and had taken the fall for her friend Holly. After he saved her, Batman and Catwoman finally admitted their powerful mutual attraction and became romantically involved. Against the odds, they were truly happy together, and Batman ultimately proposed marriage, which Selina accepted. But in the end, she broke off the engagement, feeling that being with her would compromise what makes Batman the force for good that he is in the world.

When Bruce Wayne and Selina decided to pursue their romantic relationship, she reluctantly decided to call off their nuptials, believing that going through with their marriage would inevitably impede Bruce's desire to continue his war on crime as Batman. However, Catwoman discovered this decision was influenced by the manipulation of the villain Bane to psychologically damage Bruce through the trauma of their canceled wedding. Catwoman would ally herself once again and help Batman confront Bane and take back control of Gotham City. While the two chose not to continue their relationship, they remain close allies. Their complicated and tragic romance story continues and the two remain in each other's lives.

guide.overview: Catwoman is an **elusive Warrior** who **steals enemy ATK** to boost her own power and keeps increasing her **ability to dodge attacks**.

legacyPieces.name: Promethium Claws
legacyPieces.reason: Grants Catwoman a shield when her HP gets low. Her Dodge increases over time, and this shield helps her survive early on, giving her time to snowball with her Attack-steal effects.

legacyPieces.name: Not-So-Huge Hammer
legacyPieces.reason: Increases HP, Attack, and Crit Damage. Catwoman grows stronger by stealing enemy Attack, so a higher Attack makes her steals even more threatening, and the Crit Damage bonus fits her DPS role perfectly.

legacyPieces.name: Razor Rib Umbrella
legacyPieces.reason: Increases HP and Attack, giving Catwoman a stronger foundation so she can deal solid damage even before she starts stealing enemy Attack.
